title: Bijectivity of the comparison for a supplied coherent finite-site section cocone
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $j$, let $P_j$ be a precoverage on $F(j)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with isomorphism covers, finite indexed composition and base-change stability [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage], and covering pullbacks. Assume every covering presieve has finitely many arrows. Each transition functor $F(a)$ maps covering presieves to covering presieves, preserves pullbacks of a covering arrow along any arrow, and is continuous for the generated topologies. Let $V$ be a cocone of $F$ whose object and arrow set cocones are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Let $Q$ be a precoverage on $V.pt$ with the same finite closure, isomorphism and covering-pullback properties. Its covers are precisely transported images along the $V_j$ of stage covers. Assume each $V_j$ is continuous and preserves covering pullbacks. Fix $i\in J$, an abelian sheaf $G$ on $P_i$, and $U\in F(i)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For $t\in\mathrm{Under}(i)$ put $L_t=F(t.hom)^{-1}G$, $W_t=F(t.hom)(U)$, and put $L=V_i^{-1}G$. Supply sheaf maps $\alpha_t:L_t\to V_{t.right,*}L$ and $\theta_b:L_t\to F(b.right)_*L_{t'}$ for every $b:t\to t'$ [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-site-abelian-section-diagram]. Require, for every $X\in F(i)$, that the $F(t.hom)$ unit at $X$ followed by $\alpha_t$ at $F(t.hom)(X)$ equals the $V_i$ unit at $X$ in the arrow category, and that this same stage unit followed by $\theta_b$ equals the $F(t'.hom)$ unit at $X$ in the arrow category. Supply a diagram $D:\mathrm{Under}(i)\to\mathrm{Ab}$, isomorphisms $E_t:D(t)\cong L_t(W_t)$, a cocone $K$ of $D$, and an isomorphism $e:K.pt\cong L(V_iU)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Require $\mathrm{Arrow.mk}(K_t\circ e)=\mathrm{Arrow.mk}(E_t\circ\alpha_t(W_t))$ and $\mathrm{Arrow.mk}(E_t\circ\theta_b(W_t))=\mathrm{Arrow.mk}(D(b)\circ E_{t'})$, including the endpoint transports. Then the canonical additive map $\operatorname{colimit.desc}(D,K):\operatorname{colimit}D\to K.pt$ is bijective on underlying sets. No construction of $D$, $E$, $K$, $e$, or a natural family of source units is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the existing abelian inverse-image section representative theorem to e.hom y. Transfer the stage representative through (E t).inv. Evaluate the heterogeneous arrow equation hK under the forgetful functor to Type using the generalized private arrow_map_apply_heq lemma (proved from Mathlib Arrow.mk_inj). This evaluation and the inverse-hom identity identify the image with e.hom y; injectivity of e.hom gives the required colimit representative and colimit.ι_desc computes its image.

Represent a filtered colimit element by Concrete.colimit_exists_rep. Compute its zero image using colimit.ι_desc, apply the strictly smaller eventual-zero theorem to its stage representative, and use colimit.w_apply and map_zero to conclude it is zero. The additive kernel criterion then gives injectivity.

theorem colimit_site_finite_section_comparison_bijective
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (P : ∀ j : J, Precoverage (F.obj j))
    [∀ j, (P j).HasIsos] [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [∀ j, (P j).IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [∀ j, (P j).HasPullbacks]
    (hfinite : ∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
      Finite R.uncurry)
    (hcover : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → R.map (F.map a).toFunctor ∈ P k ((F.map a).toFunctor.obj X))
    (hpullback : ∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X),
      R ∈ P j X → ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
        PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor)
    [∀ (j k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      (F.map a).toFunctor.IsContinuous (P j).toGrothendieck (P k).toGrothendieck]
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (Q : Precoverage V.pt)
    [Q.HasIsos] [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteComposition]
    [Q.IsStableUnderFiniteBaseChange] [Q.HasPullbacks]
    (hQ : (∀ (Y : V.pt) (R : Presieve Y), R ∈ Q Y ↔
          ∃ (j : J) (X : F.obj j) (S : Presieve X) (h : (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.obj X = Y),
            S ∈ P j X ∧ h ▸ S.map (V.ι.app j).toFunctor = R))
    (hVpullback : (∀ (j : J) (X Y Z : F.obj j) (R : Presieve X), R ∈ P j X →
            ∀ (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X), R f →
              PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor))
    [∀ j : J, (V.ι.app j).toFunctor.IsContinuous
      (P j).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck]
    (i : J) (G : Sheaf (P i).toGrothendieck AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (α : ∀ t : Under i,
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((V.ι.app t.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck
          Q.toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (θ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      (sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G ⟶
      ((F.map b.right).toFunctor.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj
        ((sheafPullback (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
          t'.right).toGrothendieck).obj G))
    (hα : ∀ (t : Under i) (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫ (α t).hom.app
        (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (hθ : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t') (X : F.obj i),
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X) ≫
        (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj X))) =
      Arrow.mk (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous (F.map t'.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
        i).toGrothendieck (P t'.right).toGrothendieck).unit.app G).hom.app (op X)))
    (U : F.obj i)
    (D : Under i ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (E : ∀ t : Under i, D.obj t ≅
      ((sheafPullback (F.map t.hom).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P i).toGrothendieck (P
        t.right).toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (K : Cocone D) (e : K.pt ≅ ((sheafPullback (V.ι.app i).toFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (P
      i).toGrothendieck Q.toGrothendieck).obj G).obj.obj (op ((V.ι.app i).toFunctor.obj U)))
    (hK : ∀ t : Under i, Arrow.mk (K.ι.app t ≫ e.hom) =
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫ (α t).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))))
    (hD : ∀ (t t' : Under i) (b : t ⟶ t'),
      Arrow.mk ((E t).hom ≫ (θ t t' b).hom.app (op ((F.map t.hom).toFunctor.obj U))) =
      Arrow.mk (D.map b ≫ (E t').hom)) : Function.Bijective (colimit.desc D K)
